parts.name: Drawer
parts.Basic_description: A rectangular wooden drawer that fits into the front section of the table.
parts.Functional_description: Used for storing small items such as stationery or accessories.
parts.Movement_description: Slides in and out along rails for access.

parts.name: Shelf
parts.Basic_description: A flat wooden shelf located below the drawer.
parts.Functional_description: Provides additional storage or display space.
parts.Movement_description: Fixed in place, does not move.

parts.name: Back Panel
parts.Basic_description: A vertical wooden panel at the back of the table structure.
parts.Functional_description: Provides structural support and stability to the table frame.

parts.name: Vertical Side Panel (Left)
parts.Basic_description: A vertical wooden side panel on the left side of the drawer compartment.
parts.Functional_description: Supports the drawer and connects the tabletop to the legs.

parts.name: Vertical Side Panel (Right)
parts.Basic_description: A vertical wooden side panel on the right side of the drawer compartment.
parts.Functional_description: Supports the drawer and connects the tabletop to the legs.

parts.name: Leg (Front Left)
parts.Basic_description: A sturdy wooden leg located at the front left corner of the table.
parts.Functional_description: Supports the table and maintains balance.

parts.name: Leg (Front Right)
parts.Basic_description: A sturdy wooden leg located at the front right corner of the table.
parts.Functional_description: Supports the table and maintains balance.

parts.name: Leg (Back Left)
parts.Basic_description: A sturdy wooden leg located at the back left corner of the table.
parts.Functional_description: Supports the table and maintains balance.

parts.name: Leg (Back Right)
parts.Basic_description: A sturdy wooden leg located at the back right corner of the table.
parts.Functional_description: Supports the table and maintains balance.

parts.name: Tabletop Connector
parts.Basic_description: A narrow wooden connector piece beneath the tabletop.
parts.Functional_description: Connects the tabletop to the frame and provides structural integrity.

parts.name: Bar Stretcher
parts.Basic_description: A horizontal wooden bar connecting the legs for reinforcement.

parts.name: Tabletop
parts.Basic_description: A flat wooden surface forming the top of the table.
parts.Functional_description: Provides the main working or display surface.
